_comment: PASS 1 for the sample read. The demo read at /site-read/?demo=1 is written FROM this outline and from nothing else, the same way production works: perception here, prose there. scripts/gen-site-read-fixture.mjs runs the shipped containment check of fixture.json against this file, so a sample read that drifts from its own evidence fails the build. A fictional practice at a domain that does not exist.
